welcome.title: 🔒 Welcome to LockrNotes
welcome.subtitle: Your Secure and Encrypted Notes
welcome.description: LockrNotes is a note-taking application focused on security and privacy. Your files can be encrypted automatically and securely, keeping your information protected.
welcome.features:
Main features:
• Automatic managed encryption for your files
• Support for text files (.txt) and structured JSON (.json)
• Modern and intuitive interface with dark theme
• Folder organization and local or remote storage
welcome.storageDescription: Choose where your files will be stored. By default, we use the "LockrNotes" folder inside your Documents. You can change this at any time in settings.
welcome.pathHelper: Full path where files will be saved
welcome.infoMessage: This folder will be created automatically if it doesn't exist. You can always change this location in the application settings.
welcome.keyStorageDescription: Choose how to protect your managed encryption key. This affects how your encrypted files can be accessed.

keyStorageOptions.systemPro: ✓ More secure - Key stored in Windows secure vault
keyStorageOptions.systemCon: ✗ If you delete system data, you'll lose access to files
keyStorageOptions.folderPro: ✓ Recoverable - If you move the folder, it still works
keyStorageOptions.folderCon: ✗ Less secure - Anyone with folder access can decrypt files

welcome.languageDescription: Choose the language that will be used in the application interface.
